US PRODUCER INFLATION COOLS SLIGHTLY BUT REMAINS ELEVATED AT 6.5%

US producer prices rose 0.3% in October, below the 0.4% forecast, while annual PPI reached 6.5%, versus 6.6% expected.

🔸 Headline PPI MoM: +0.3% vs. +0.4% expected
🔸 Headline PPI YoY: +6.5% vs. +6.6% expected
🔸 Core PPI MoM: +0.3%, in line
🔸 Core PPI YoY: +5.0%, in line
🔸 PPI excluding food, energy and trade MoM: +0.5%

The modest headline miss offers some relief, but persistent underlying price pressures reinforce concerns about inflation.

UBS sees a much larger opportunity for server CPUs as agentic AI scales. Q3 server CPU shipments rose 31% YoY and 6% QoQ, vs. typical seasonal growth of 3%.

Market share by units:
$ARM: 20.1% (+250 bps)
Intel $INTC: 51.5% (-240 bps)

UBS estimates unconstrained CPU demand could support a market exceeding $500 billion by 2030, but memory supply constraints could limit the realizable market to around $210 billion.

Analyst Timothy Arcuri wrote: "CPU demand could be substantially higher than our current forecasts."

posts.author: Wall St Engine
posts.text:
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei on why it buys compute conservatively:

"Compute is the deepest business dilemma that the company faces."

"If you buy too much ... you can financially overextend yourself. If you buy too little, then you can't support inference for customers ... you can't do the R&D."

"We actually tend to buy on the low side. We buy relatively little compute for relatively low cost ahead of time."

"If things go really well ... we have an opportunity to buy compute on the spot market. That costs more, but we're buying it in worlds where we're doing particularly well."

He compares the strategy to buying an insurance policy.

posts.author: The Kobeissi Letter
posts.text:
US credit stress is intensifying among the weakest-quality borrowers:

Spreads on CCC-rated and lower US corporate bonds are up to 13.3%, near the highest since the 2020 pandemic.

Since January 2026, this figure has surged +490 basis points.

As a result, these spreads have now surpassed the 2022 bear market peak of 12.9%.

For perspective, during the 2020 February-March surge, this metric peaked at 18.8%.

Meanwhile, the spread differential between CCC- and BBB-rated corporate debt has widened to ~1,200 basis points, its widest level in at least 5 years.

This means investors are demanding ~12 percentage points more in compensation to hold the lowest-rated debt rather than first-notch investment-grade corporate bonds.

Cracks are spreading quickly through the lowest-quality credit.
posts.ko: CCC 이하 회사채 스프레드 13.3%로 팬데믹 이후 최고권, 연초 대비 +490bp, CCC-BBB 격차 약 1,200bp로 최소 5년 내 최대

posts.text:
GOLDMAN SACHS SEES S&P 500 HITTING 8,700 IN 2027

Goldman Sachs forecasts the S&P 500 reaching 8,700 over the next 12 months, implying 14% upside from 7,619 and a 16% total return including dividends.

Chief global equity strategist Peter Oppenheimer expects 11% earnings growth in 2027, supported by more attractive valuations and lower bond yields, despite slowing AI spending growth.

Goldman favors US hyperscalers and selected defensive stocks, remaining overweight the US and Japan while underweight Europe.

The bank expects equities to keep rising, but warns volatility will remain elevated.

posts.author: The Kobeissi Letter
posts.text:
US layoffs continue to slow sharply:

US job cut announcements dropped -71% YoY in October, to 43,994, the lowest October total since 2023.

Year-to-date announcements have declined -44% YoY, to 617,189, the lowest January-October total since 2022.

This is also the 8th month of 2026 with job cuts down YoY versus the corresponding month of the prior year.

Food companies led October layoffs with 9,677 cuts, while Technology has recorded the most reductions year-to-date, at 171,501, up +21% YoY.

Market and economic conditions accounted for 16,407 announced job cuts in October, or ~37% of all layoffs, bringing the year-to-date total to 130,531, overtaking AI as the most cited reason.

US employers appear to be slowing job cuts.
posts.ko: 10월 미 감원 발표 43,994건으로 전년비 -71%, 2023년 이후 최저 10월
